selection: Maximise whole-request exact-match rate. Also report chosen-target intention and each case. Equal scores are a plateau, not proof of improvement. Validation is evaluated once after selection; never used for further tuning.
limitations: Repeated identical inputs measure response consistency, not 20 independent cube situations. Validation cases are yaw-transformed development templates, testing symmetry transfer rather than broad generalisation.
